note: Set A stays close to the schedule and notes, correctly binding items 31–34 and 50 to their CU/AL materials, conductor and conduit sizes, the 200A/2P NFDS rating, and the L1, L2, & N / NO GND and COPPER TO GND conditions. Set B invents schedule items 21, 22 and 24 (SP100E, SP105) that do not exist on the page and misreads several descriptions (item 20 as 3#10/1#12G, item 50 as 3#8/1#6, 3#4/0 as "3440"), plus misbinds 3W as a phase configuration. A's flaws are limited to two fabricated "VOLTAGE/CURRENT ORGANIZER" quotes and one misbound 2-1/2" diameter claim, while B also omits the instrumentation-panel conductor condition that A captures.
